All objectives complete. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket titled `noesc2 RD Bench Ticket` created (ref **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer", initial status Draft), confirmed present in the tickets list.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `noesc2 RD Part A` added with cost 100, markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00**.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `noesc2 RD Part B` added with cost 200, markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00**. (Parts table total at that point: $375.00.)

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 → 150 (markup kept at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50**. (Table total updated to $437.50; Part B unchanged at $250.00.)

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Status set to **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the app refused with the alert — *"Ticket is not ready — Part "noesc2 RD Part A" has no supplier — Part "noesc2 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. What was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned**. I edited both parts and set Supplier = "Acme Supplies", after which "Mark Ready" succeeded and the page showed status **Ready** (buttons changed to Mark Draft / Mark Closed).

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted (each via a confirm dialog: *"Delete the part "…" from this ticket? This cannot be undone."* → "Delete part"); the parts table then read **"No parts on this ticket yet."** The ticket was then archived — the "Archive ticket" button flipped to "Unarchive ticket" with no error. The active tickets list (RD-1014 … RD-1004) no longer contains RD-1015, so nothing created by this run remains active.

Note: one intermediate instruction timed out mid-way through the part deletions; I re-verified state on the next call (Part A was already gone, Part B remained) and completed the deletion from there, so the final state above is verified, not assumed.
